summary.root_cause_text: The payment provider at internal://payments-v1 times out, so the worker marks orders processed without recording a payment. The cause of the outage, and the correct provider URL, are not known.
recommended: Check the health of the payment provider and find the correct provider URL. Then set payment_provider_url to it.
After payments succeed again, run reprocess_orders with all_unpaid. It never double-charges.
Do not restart the worker until the provider works.
